Overview

Experience Afghanistan with local context.

Witness the dramatic transformation of the Afghan landscape as spring brings lush valleys and blooming orchards to Kabul, Bamyan, and the ancient streets of Herat.

Route: Kabul → Kabul to Herat → Herat → Herat to Kabul → Kabul to Bamyan → Bamyan → Bamyan / Band-e-Amir → Bamyan to Kabul

What's included

  • Airport pickupAirport pickup on arrival at Kabul International Airport.
  • Airport drop-offAirport transfer for departing flights from Kabul.
  • Ground transportationPrivate ground transportation for scheduled tour movements.
  • Local guide supportLocal guide support during scheduled sightseeing days.
  • Operational coordinationOn-the-ground coordination by the AfghanTours team during the tour.
  • Cultural contextLocal cultural guidance and explanation at major stops and attractions.
  • Traveler supportBasic traveler support during the scheduled tour period.

Why you'll love it

  • Visit Babur's Gardens
  • Explore Murad Khane
  • Travel the Kabul → Kabul to Herat → Herat → Herat to Kabul → Kabul to Bamyan → Bamyan → Bamyan / Band-e-Amir → Bamyan to Kabul route
  • Experience Qabuli Palaw
  • Cultural / Scenic journey with local coordination
  • Domestic flights and 4WD vehicles

Itinerary

9-day journey

The itinerary is grouped by the places you stay, so you can see how the journey moves through Afghanistan. Daily plans may shift with road conditions, weather, local access, and the final interests of your group.

Kabul City

2 nights

Day 1: Arrival and Kabul orientation

Arrival in Kabul with a soft spring orientation through gardens, markets, and historic neighborhoods.

Location Kabul Food & culture Kabob
Today's highlights

Day 2: Kabul heritage circuit

A full day linking the National Museum, Darulaman Palace, Sakhi Shrine, and city viewpoints.

Location Kabul Food & culture Qabuli Palaw
Today's highlights

Herat City

2 nights

Day 3: Fly to Herat and old city introduction

Domestic flight to Herat when available, followed by the old city, bazaars, and first views of Timurid-era architecture.

Location Kabul to Herat Food & culture Saffron Tea
Today's highlights

Day 4: Herat mosque, citadel, and minarets

A focused Herat day around the Friday Mosque, Herat Citadel, Musalla minarets, tilework, and old-city lanes.

Location Herat Food & culture Saffron Tea
Today's highlights

Kabul City

1 night

Day 5: Return to Kabul and prepare for Bamyan

Morning buffer for Herat or return flight to Kabul, followed by vehicle preparation for the central highlands.

Location Herat to Kabul Food & culture Green Tea
Today's highlights

Bamyan City

3 nights

Day 6: Drive to Bamyan

Overland drive by 4WD into Bamyan with stops adjusted around daylight, season, and road conditions.

Location Kabul to Bamyan Food & culture Ash
Today's highlights

Day 7: Bamyan monuments and valley sites

Explore the Buddha Niches, Shahr-e-Gholghola, Shahr-e-Zohak, and nearby valley viewpoints.

Location Bamyan Food & culture Mantu
Today's highlights

Day 8: Band-e-Amir or return route buffer

Visit Band-e-Amir if conditions allow, or use the day as a weather and road buffer in the Bamyan area.

Location Bamyan / Band-e-Amir Food & culture Green Tea
Today's highlights

Kabul City

1 night

Day 9: Return to Kabul and departure

Return to Kabul by 4WD and position for departure or post-tour hotel night.

Location Bamyan to Kabul Food & culture Green Tea

Today's highlight

Know before you go

Practical trip information

Open each section for the planning information most relevant to this journey.

Passport, visa & entry requirements

Entry requirements depend on nationality and current rules. AfghanTours can explain the supporting documentation available for confirmed travelers, but travelers should verify current official requirements before departure.

Arrival & departure information

Arrival and departure transfers are coordinated around the confirmed itinerary and flight schedule. Final pickup details are provided before travel.

Physical activity level & mobility

This tour is rated Moderate. Walking, altitude, road time, stairs, uneven surfaces, and other physical requirements are reviewed during trip planning.

Transportation on tour

Domestic flights and 4WD vehicles

Typical transport: SUV (Standard / Older Model), 4x4 SUV (Premium / Newer Model), Toyota Land Cruiser 200

Clothing & packing tips

Packing guidance is provided before departure. Clothing and equipment needs vary by season, altitude, destination, and the activities included in your itinerary.

Hotels on tour

3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul, Herat and Bamyan

Health

Travelers should discuss personal medical needs, vaccinations, medications, altitude concerns, and travel insurance with qualified professionals before departure. Tell AfghanTours about mobility or dietary requirements that affect trip planning.

Meals & Afghan cuisine

Meals vary by region and itinerary. Local dishes and food experiences can be incorporated where practical, and dietary requirements should be discussed before travel.

Currency & payments

Cash remains the most practical form of payment for many day-to-day expenses in Afghanistan, and card acceptance is limited. Current money guidance is provided before departure.

Wi-Fi, mobile data & connectivity

Mobile data and Wi-Fi are available in many cities and hotels, but speed and reliability vary significantly along the route.

Guides & on-tour support

Trips are coordinated by AfghanTours from Kabul with local guides, drivers, hotels, and other partners selected according to the itinerary.

Photography

Photography rules vary by location. Travelers should ask before photographing people and follow local guidance around government, military, religious, and other sensitive sites.

Time zones

Afghanistan uses Afghanistan Time (UTC+4:30) throughout the year.

Responsible travel

Guests are expected to respect local customs, dress guidance, religious practices, communities, photography preferences, and site-specific instructions throughout the journey.

Afghanistan Discovery Tour Spring

The Discovery Tour is a balanced overview of Afghanistan’s highlights, combining major cities, cultural landmarks, and natural scenery.

Tour Profile

  • Duration: 9 days
  • Travel style: Cultural / Scenic
  • Activity level: Moderate
  • Season: Apr-Jun

What This Tour Is For

This nine-day journey is for travelers who want a broad introduction to Afghanistan through Kabul, Herat, and Bamyan during the April–June travel window. It combines major heritage sites with overland movement into the central highlands while keeping the Bamyan road and Band-e-Amir day responsive to actual conditions.

Planning Notes

Final routing, hotels, transport, and pricing should be confirmed after reviewing group size, travel dates, road conditions, flight availability, permits, and current local operating requirements.
